scientific_integrity: The reported theorem is an analytic mathematical result for a one-sided modified model. Computational grid checks are supporting examples, not a global proof. No independent scientific audit has been conducted.
scientific_limitations: Global upper age-mortality bound and positive starvation mortality are required; ultimate bound need not be sharp. Does not establish coexistence, stability, or blowup of the unsaturated model.
title: One-sided saturation prevents runaway growth in an age-structured role-reversal population model
